title: Effect of Sintering Temperature on the Microstructure and Integrated Properties of MgAlTiVFeCo Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy

recollection.structure: Guess: Changes in grain size, phase composition, and porosity with temperature
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Higher sintering temperatures promote diffusion, densification, and possible phase transformations
recollection.results: Guess: Optimal sintering temperature yields improved mechanical properties and possibly enhanced corrosion resistance; quantitative results likely include hardness, density, and microstructural metrics as a function of temperature

score.note: The recollection gives only generic, guessed effects of varying sintering temperature. It does not identify SPS at 1000 °C, the dense microstructure with specific oxide barrier phases, the passive-film/Cl− blocking and parabolic oxidation mechanisms, or any numerical density, hardness, oxidation, or corrosion results.
